scope: Focused search for compatible heat-treatment quality data, then an independent manufacturing case. Not an exhaustive catalog.

candidates.name: KAMP 열처리 품질보증 60
candidates.evidence: Locally verified 2,939,722 sensor rows and 136 batch quality labels; original hashes unchanged.
candidates.conditions: Existing source/citation agreement; original and personalized guide remain local.

candidates.name: KAMP 열처리 공정최적화 61
candidates.decision: Do not count as new independent quality data
candidates.evidence: Official page shows same 2,939,722 sensor rows, 136 label rows, first batch102410 and first timestamp2022-01-03. Strong overlap indication; byte identity not checked.
candidates.conditions: Page says content modification allowed; not a complete redistribution license. Not downloaded.

candidates.name: KAMP 열처리 예지보전 43
candidates.decision: Not selected for supervised product-quality validation
candidates.evidence: Official page describes Autoencoder equipment anomaly detection, 2,889,195 raw rows and345,390 processed rows. Preview shares batch102410 and2022-01-03 timestamp. Independent product inspection labels not established.
candidates.conditions: Page says content modification allowed. No download attempted because suitability was not established.

candidates.name: 명장 플랫폼 열처리 후보
candidates.decision: Unavailable for current acquisition, not counted as secured
candidates.evidence: Official assessment report mentions152,300 heat-treatment records. Direct browser access failed ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED; labels, batch independence, file size and current license not verified.
candidates.conditions: No authentication or payment submitted; no download.

candidates.name: UCI SECOM179
candidates.decision: Downloaded and trained as a separate semiconductor case
candidates.evidence: Actual production entities with original in-house line test pass/fail.1567rows,104failures; downloaded numeric matrix590signals. Website591-feature count discrepancy recorded. Units/physical meanings and lot identifiers absent.
candidates.conditions: CC BY4.0. McCann,M. & Johnston,A.(2008), DOI10.24432/C54305. No login/payment required.
candidates.use: Separate time-split methods benchmark; cannot validate the heat-treatment model or be pooled with KAMP.

other_portals.finding: Search did not establish a directly downloadable compatible heat-treatment batch-quality dataset with verified labels and terms.
Search results checked did not establish linked batch-level heat-treatment quality labels; energy/directory data are not a substitute.
Heat-treatment sensor/anomaly listings were found, but independent product-quality ground truth and license were not established.
